items.title: What Is Really Behind CrowdStrike Stock's Doubling?
items.summary: CrowdStrike (CRWD) trades at $210.02, roughly double where it stood a year ago while the S&P 500 returned 19.3%, and it sits at about 91% of its 52-week high. The easy read is that the AI security trade has already happened and you are late to it. But its own recurring revenue base points at something steadier than a spike, and the price now assumes that steadiness.
